title: Apple Mail data
whyItMatters: Mail keeps local copies of messages, attachments and account settings. A new owner could read correspondence that was never deleted.
source: macOS Apple Mail artifacts under ~/Library/Mail - https://www.macfor.io/compatibility (TCC-protected Mail collection)
notes: TCC-protected: without Full Disk Access the folder returns 'Operation not permitted' on a live system. Mailboxes are counted, never read.
